normalized_review.title: Bad experience, No Accountability & Extremely Poor Customer Support of the
normalized_review.text:
Bad experience, No Accountability & Extremely Poor Customer Support of the. I had a really bad experience with Urban Company, and I’m extremely disappointed with the way this entire situation has been handled.

I purchased a 3-day package and completed bookings for the first two days. However, the professional scheduled for the third day never showed up.

What I don’t understand is that if your assigned professional is unavailable or unable to show up for the service, why isn’t another professional assigned as a replacement? If a customer has booked a service for a particular day, selected a time slot, and paid for it in advance, it is Urban Company’s responsibility to arrange an alternative professional if the originally assigned person cannot make it.

Why should the customer have to suffer because of an issue at your end? I booked the service for a specific day because I needed it that day. I don’t necessarily need it on some other day. Why should I have to keep waiting or adjust my schedule because your team couldn’t fulfil the booking?

What makes the experience even worse is that when I try to contact customer support, I’m only directed to an AI chatbot. There is no option to speak to an actual customer service representative who can understand the issue and provide a proper resolution.

After cancelling the missed booking, I tried to reschedule it for tomorrow, but surprisingly, there were zero slots available on my account.

Now here’s what I don’t understand: when I tried checking the availability using my own phone number, the slots for tomorrow were clearly available!

How is this possible? I purchased a 3-day package using my mother’s phone number, and since there is still one booking remaining in that package, obviously I should be able to use it to make the booking. Why are the slots unavailable on that account when the exact same slots are showing as available when I try booking through another number?

This is completely unfair and makes no sense. I have already paid for the package, and it is Urban Company’s responsibility to ensure that I receive all the services included in it.

I expect a proper resolution, not an automated response.A customer should not have to bear the consequences of your operational issues.

This experience has genuinely been disappointing, and I would expect much better service from a platform like Urban Company.
